title: A constant multiple c[[U]] of an open subset of ℝⁿ is integer multiplicity only if c ∈ ℤ
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, n := m+1, U ⊆ ℝⁿ open and nonempty, c ∈ ℝ, and X ∈ D_n(U) integer multiplicity with X(ω) = c∫_U ω(x)(e_1,…,e_n) dx for every ω ∈ D^n(U), where e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 and dx is Lebesgue measure. Then c ∈ ℤ.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (c : ℝ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsOpen U → U.Nonempty → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), X ω = c * ∫ x in U, (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) ∂volume) → ∃ k : ℤ, c = k
